Meet the cast

Sometime in the
near-future…

A poisonous miasma has driven people below ground. Generations pass, and the blue sky becomes a distant memory. But a quiet miner and a young girl with unusual powers believe there is more to the world.

Follow John and Sam along the railway, beyond the safety of their subterranean home. Meet the people who remain above, discover the source of Sam’s abilities, and unravel the mystery hanging over the land.

A richly detailed adventure from Shanghai studio Pixpil, published by Chucklefish.
